description_en: Creates a FeatureStore project. A project is a container for a feature entity, a feature view, and a model feature
description_zh: 创建 FeatureStore 项目。项目是特征实体、特征视图、模型特征的容器
kebab_example: aliyun paifeaturestore create-project --instance-id fs-cn-00000000 --name project1 --workspace-id 324 --offline-datasource-id 4 --online-datasource-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the FeatureStore instance. You can call the ListInstances operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: FeatureStore 实例 ID。可通过 ListInstances 接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the project. The description is displayed in the PAI console
parameters.help_zh: 项目描述，展示在 PAI 控制台
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The name must be unique within the instance. The name must be 2 to 18 characters in length, start with a letter, and contain only letters, digits, and underscores (regular expression: ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]+$)
parameters.help_zh: 项目名称，在实例内唯一。长度 2~18 字符，以字母开头，只能包含字母、数字和下划线（正则：^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]+$）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the offline store. The offline store must be of the MaxCompute type. You can call the ListDatasources operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 离线数据源 ID，必须是 MaxCompute 类型。可通过 ListDatasources 接口获取
parameters.name: offline_datasource_id

parameters.help_en: The retention period in days for offline tables created by FeatureStore. This parameter does not affect existing tables registered by using the RegisterTable operation. Default value: 0 (not automatically cleared)
parameters.help_zh: FeatureStore 自建离线表的保留天数，不影响用户通过 RegisterTable 注册的已有表。默认值：0（不自动清理）
parameters.name: offline_life_cycle

parameters.help_en: The ID of the online store. The online store supports the Hologres, TableStore, or FeatureDB type. You can call the ListDatasources operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 在线数据源 ID，支持 Hologres、TableStore 或 FeatureDB 类型。可通过 ListDatasources 接口获取
parameters.name: online_datasource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PAI workspace. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: workspace_id
